name: 出差出行
blurb: 在国外出差的一路：值机、酒店、打车、点餐、结账，遇到问题也说得出来。

scenes.title: 值机要个过道座
scenes.situation: 在机场值机柜台。你要飞东京，想要一个过道的座位，还有一个箱子要托运。
scenes.model: Hi, I'd like to check in for the flight to Tokyo. Could I get an aisle seat, please? And I have one bag to check.

scenes.title: 酒店入住提个要求
scenes.situation: 到酒店前台。你用 Wang 这个名字订了房，想要一间安静、楼层高一点的房间。
scenes.model: Hi, I have a reservation under Wang. If possible, I'd like a quiet room on a higher floor.

scenes.title: 房间空调坏了
scenes.situation: 打电话给前台：你房间的空调坏了，特别热。请他们派人来修，或者给你换个房间。
scenes.model: Hi, this is room 1208. The air conditioning isn't working, and it's really hot in here. Could you send someone up, or maybe move me to another room?

scenes.title: 打车赶时间
scenes.situation: 上了出租车。告诉司机去第五大道的希尔顿，你有点赶时间，问大概要多久。
scenes.model: Could you take me to the Hilton on Fifth Avenue? I'm in a bit of a hurry. About how long will it take?

chunks.en: in a bit of a hurry

scenes.title: 航班取消要改签
scenes.situation: 你的航班刚被取消。去柜台问能不能改到今晚最早的一班，明天的会不能错过。
scenes.model: My flight just got canceled. Is there any way you could put me on the earliest flight tonight? I really can't miss my meeting tomorrow.

scenes.title: 点一杯咖啡
scenes.situation: 在咖啡店点一杯大杯拿铁，要燕麦奶，带走。
scenes.model: Can I get a large latte with oat milk, please? To go.

scenes.title: 没订位，问要等多久
scenes.situation: 到餐厅才发现没订位。问有没有两个人的桌子、要等多久，说坐吧台也行。
scenes.model: Hi, do you have a table for two? We don't have a reservation. How long is the wait? We're happy to sit at the bar.

scenes.title: 问推荐，说忌口
scenes.situation: 菜单看不太懂。问服务员推荐什么，说你不能吃太辣，还对花生过敏。
scenes.model: What would you recommend? I can't eat anything too spicy, and I'm allergic to peanuts.

scenes.title: 菜上错了
scenes.situation: 端上来的是牛肉，可你点的是鸡肉。礼貌地说一下，再说不着急。
scenes.model: Excuse me, I think there's been a mix-up. I ordered the chicken, not the beef. No rush, though.

scenes.title: 结账，分开付
scenes.situation: 吃完要结账。问能不能分开付，你们俩都刷卡。
scenes.model: Could we get the check, please? And is it okay to split the bill? We'll both pay by card.

plays.title: 酒店房间不满意
plays.setup: 你刚入住，发现房间对着马路，很吵，窗户也关不严。你下楼找前台 Daniel。
plays.goal: 说清问题，争取换一间安静的房，或者一点补偿。
plays.persona: You are Daniel, a polite front desk clerk at a busy hotel in New York. The hotel is almost fully booked. Listen to the guest's complaint, ask for details, apologize, and offer options step by step: first a room change tomorrow, then a quieter room tonight if they insist, or a free breakfast.
plays.opener: Good evening. How can I help you?

plays.title: 在餐厅点菜
plays.setup: 你和一位同事在一家美式餐厅，服务员 Maria 来点菜。你们一个不吃辣，一个不吃牛肉。
plays.goal: 问推荐、说忌口，把两个人的菜点好。
plays.persona: You are Maria, a cheerful server at an American restaurant. Greet the customers, explain a few dishes simply, ask about drinks, sides and how they want their food cooked, and check for allergies.
plays.opener: Hi folks, welcome in! Can I start you off with something to drink?
